note: Only Ivy League or US News 2026 National Universities top 20. All online, GRE not required. Physics undergrad + Capital One SWE. Cut Georgia Tech / UIUC / UT Austin — famous for CS, not overall top 20. UChicago MPCS and Northwestern MSAI are not online.

schools.why: Ivy, US News #10. Official path: physics degree + 2+ years as a software engineer. Better match than MAS-CS given your job.
schools.fitNote: This is the Penn program to apply to. Skip MSE-AI — they want a CS/CE undergrad degree.
schools.notes: Spring 2027: opens May 22, 2026; final deadline Oct 26, 2026. 2 recommenders + personal statement.

schools.why: Ivy, US News #10. Built for non-CS majors. Physics is the quantitative proof they want.
schools.fitNote: Highest Ivy admit chance — but classes start at CS foundations. May feel basic after 4 years at Capital One. Apply only if you want the Penn CS name more than the coursework.
schools.notes: Same cycle as MSE-DS. Same degree brand as the old MCIT Online.

schools.why: US News #6. No GRE. Physics + SWE is a normal profile. Evening classes work if you stay in Chicago.
schools.fitNote: This is UChicago's actual online master's. MPCS (the CS one) is in-person only. Diploma says Applied Data Science, not Computer Science.
schools.notes: Autumn 2027 online deadline June 23, 2027. Cohort can fill early.

schools.why: US News #7. Built for working engineers/scientists. Physics + SWE is a standard admit. Rolling, ~2–3 week decisions.
schools.fitNote: Real CS master's from a top-10 overall school. Diploma does not say 'online.'
schools.notes: 3 starts (fall/spring/summer). Missing undergrad CS prereqs can be filled after a provisional admit.

schools.why: US News #20. Built for working software engineers. Physics counts as a technical undergrad. They want real job experience — that's you.
schools.fitNote: Diploma says Master of Science – Software Engineering, not 'online.' There is a coding assessment after you apply.
schools.notes: Spring 2027: apply Aug 19–Oct 14, 2026. Need 3 recommenders + video essay.

schools.why: US News #17. They want a science/engineering bachelor's + real programming. Physics + backend work matches.
schools.fitNote: Real CS master's. 3 starts a year, decisions in a few weeks after the deadline.
schools.notes: Spring 2027 deadline Nov 1, 2026. Need 3 letters of recommendation.

schools.why: Ivy, US News #15. Same Columbia Engineering MS as campus students.
schools.fitNote: Work experience does not waive their 6 for-credit prereqs (4 CS + 2 math). Physics covers math; you likely still need university CS courses (not Coursera). Their non-CS Bridge program is in-person only.
schools.notes: Spring 2027 deadline Oct 15, 2026. Min GPA 3.3; most admits are 3.5+.
